ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) ratio estimated at approximately 85:15 across the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity central region; contiguous low-intensity pigmentation concentrated along the trailing edge, median notch, and lobe tips; minor dark speckling present in the lower central and right-central fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an interior pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees; depth corresponds to roughly 18% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary; jagged topography with pixel variations between 4 and 12 pixels from the local boundary mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edges of both lobes, terminating in upward-swept, pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of small, dark circular pixel clusters located in the lower central region near the notch and mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable indentation/irregularity at the terminal tip of the left fluke lobe.
